decision_order: judge target ROI validity from the crop alone
if a biologically relevant target flower is evaluable, judge flower condition
do not assign any colour morph/state during this review
direct_colour_calibration_gate: A record enters the direct fresh calibration set only when reviewer1 and reviewer2 both independently classify target ROI as usable and condition as fresh.
disagreement_rule: Any reviewer1/reviewer2 disagreement in ROI usability or fresh condition is withheld from direct calibration and routed to a separate third adjudication; no majority or confidence threshold is applied automatically.
reviewer1_excluded_record_rule: A reviewer2 usable+fresh decision cannot by itself restore a reviewer1-excluded record; restoration requires third adjudication.
reviewer1_included_record_rule: A reviewer2 non-usable or non-fresh decision removes a reviewer1-included record from the direct set pending third adjudication.
reason_no_global_threshold: The reconciliation is record-level and deterministic, avoiding a post-hoc pooled agreement threshold.
next_gate: reconcile r1/r2 at record level, adjudicate disagreements, then rerun geometry on the consensus fresh/evaluable calibration subset before freezing colour rules
